attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between node2 (lan-a) and node3 (lan-b) with a single explicit pass rule allowing TCP/8080 from lan-a to node3, leaving all other cross-network traffic default-denied. Set up static IPs on node2/node3's second NIC (eth1: 10.60.1.10/24 and 10.60.2.10/24) and OPNsense opt1/opt2 interfaces (10.60.1.1/10.60.2.1) with a persisted route on each Alpine node via post-up. Verified TCP/8080 succeeds, other TCP ports and ICMP are refused, and the reverse direction (node3->node2) is also refused. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (node1, node2, node3), capturing pre/post boot identity (FreeBSD kern.boottime for node1, Linux boot_id for node2/node3) and confirming full functional recovery (interfaces, filter rules, routes, and end-to-end TCP/8080 connectivity with correct denial of other traffic) after each restart.
